eco.t002: Read this table as: what it is, where it comes from, what it turns into.
eco.t006: Everywhere. Training Room [EP1 > Special] has an NPC that hands out 999,999 for free.
eco.t007: Shops, and a few quests that ask for a specific amount.
eco.t009: Traded from Photon Drop x98, or dropped in some quests.
eco.t010: Drops from every monster during token mini-events. Custom drops in many quests at 1/400 to 1/1000. Also sold in the Bazaar in stacks of 5.
eco.t011: Adds Hit% to a weapon (Paganini, up to 80). Trades for Legendary Crates with Hopkins.
eco.t012: The Phantasmal Dimension, Hallowed World [Master], Lost Soul Ripper [Extreme], Toward the Multiverse and more, roughly 1/64 to 1/500. Also Photon Drop x25 → 1 in TPD.
eco.t013: Harmony of Despair I, VR Test Destiny: Underground (secret floor), VR Test FINAL: Catastrophe, Walking through Flames, and the Legendary, Phantasmal and Valentine crates.
eco.t014: Millennium/HP needs 10. Some quests need one to start.
eco.t015: Replaced the Weapon Badge x20 requirement in Ver.0.942.
eco.t017: One each for V803 and Phantasmal Field. Also a material for Ignis Engine.
eco.t018: MATRIX SCOPE needs two red and two blue.
eco.t019: Quest specific. Blue from VR Test EXTRA: Singularity 1/24, Red from VR Test Destiny: Sandstorm 1/204, Yellow from The Eternal Age 1/102, Green from Christmas Fiasco [EP4] 1/393.
eco.t020: Tool items used to receive an item from an NPC.
eco.t021: Simulator 2.0 [EP1] and Random Attack Xrd Stage [EP2], on clearing the secret area.
eco.t023: From Ver.0.94 onward it can no longer be exchanged for mags.
eco.t024: Hopkins in VR Test Destiny: Underground, and the secret NPC in The Phantasmal Dimension.
eco.t025: An older version of the daily crate. Weapons can roll up to 100%.
eco.t026: Anything that stacks to 99 can be held up to 250 since Ver.0.715. That includes Photon Token, crates and event currencies.
eco.t027: At the Bazaar counter you can also put a fake special on a weapon for 50 Photon Drop. It only changes the displayed name, so it does not add the real effect.
eco.t029: The main trade hub, formerly called the Spooky Bazaar. Several NPCs stand here and each one handles a different exchange.
eco.t033: Added over several updates. Check in game for the current material list.
eco.t035: Adds Hit% to a weapon, up to 80.
eco.t036: Opens the Halloween, Xmas and Another shops.
eco.t038: A fake special on a weapon, for example a 'Burning' DARK FLOW.
eco.t039: Mags from the Mag Shop always arrive at Lv0 with M&Y+2 and a random Photon Blast.
eco.t040: The Mag Shop added in Ver.0.94.
eco.t042: Bring the required items and talk to the trade NPC in the Bazaar quest.
eco.t043: The Millennium Shop sits inside The Phantastic Bazaar.
eco.t049: Pays out by clear time and level. Includes S-Rank guns and weapons with an attribute.
eco.t050: Hopkins is Ultimate only and trades once per run, or twice if you defeat the secret Gol Dragon. If you do not trade, you get a Photon Drop as the clear reward instead. Clearing the secret floor also gives a Weapon Crystal Badge.
eco.t051: Paganini in The Phantasmal Dimension trades only once per run. The Spirit Flow NPC needs the secret floors cleared first.
eco.t053: Event shops open inside The Phantastic Bazaar while the event runs. Event currencies drop from every monster during the period.
eco.t055: Traded from Paganini. Same materials as the year-round version.
eco.t056: The Valentine exchange NPC stays in the Bazaar all year. The others close with the event.
eco.t057: Source: the Discord patch note channels and the Bazaar and currency channel. Item names, amounts and drop rates follow the original English notation and are not translated.
eco.t060: Almost every strong item on this server is traded, not dropped. This page puts the currencies and the trade NPCs side by side, so you can see what a material is for before you start farming it.
